text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 88 bags of clindamycin in 5 percent dextrose 6 mg/mL 50 mL bag (NDC 0781-3288-09), providing 6.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 78 bags with 19.2 days on hand. Other Corvale sites hold alternative clindamycin strengths and formulations with 11 to 19 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the clindamycin phosphate injection shortage on 2023-03-21 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. The FDA shortage list names Baxter Healthcare, Pfizer Inc., Sagent Pharmaceuticals, and Sandoz Inc. as current suppliers for this product. Our 6 mg/mL 50 mL bags are labeled by Sandoz Inc. and manufactured at InfoRLife SA, a plant not placed in FDA's registration database. Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189), a registered plant for another clindamycin NDC, was inspected 2023-06-16 and classified VAI.

Our position: The rule-ranked option is to transfer 21 bags from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to 8 days on hand while Corvale Lakeside retains approximately two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 21 bags of 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires approval by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Civica, Inc. — not on FDA shortage list today; plant is InfoRLife SA — requires approval by buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — requires approval by buyer.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
